title: quasi-category
description: A simplicial set in which every inner horn Λⁿₖ (0 < k < n) has a filler: each map Λⁿₖ → X extends to Δⁿ → X. Composites of morphisms then exist but are unique only up to a contractible space of choices. The standard model of an ∞-category. A simplicial set refined by inner-horn filling.

inner-horn-filling.description: every inner horn Λⁿₖ → X (0 < k < n) extends to Δⁿ → X
